biblical_reference.note: Taphtatharah (תפתתרה) is the name of a woman in the Hebrew Bible who is referred to as Tamma in the Greek and Latin versions. In Judges 4:6, she is the mother of Deborah, a prophetess and judge in Israel. In 1 Samuel 25:43, she is a wife of Abimelech and is captured by David.
